messages:
sophie: Quick heads-up: a user reported the curl snippet in docs/api/quickstart.md returns a 403 when hitting the sample asset (image). Looks like the image moved to the new CDN. Can someone swap the URL and do a tiny PR?
ashok: I can pick this up. Which image and file?
sophie: File: docs/api/quickstart.md. Image reference: https://cdn-old.example.com/samples/quickstart.png -> should be /assets/samples/quickstart.png (our normalized path). Also please update frontmatter last_edited and add a one-liner under "Troubleshooting" that image paths were rehosted 2025-04-02.
ashok: Plan: replace absolute URL with relative `/assets/samples/quickstart.png`, run `mkdocs build` locally, and confirm snippet curl works against the preview. Will also add CHANGELOG entry. ETA ~20m.
michael: Quick check: is this likely to affect external links? If so we might want a redirect; otherwise relative path is fine.
sophie: I don't think it's externally linked, just the sample used by the quickstart. No redirect needed for now.
ashok: Opening small PR now. Title: "docs: quickstart sample image rehost". I'll mark as smallfix and add changelog.
deply-bot: (typo)
deploy-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8472 — status: open — labels: docs, smallfix
ashok: Local smoke: `mkdocs build && mkdocs serve --dev-addr=127.0.0.1:8001` then curl the preview page. Image loads locally. Pushed commit and changelog update.
michael: I'll review once CI preview is ready. One tiny nit: make sure the markdown uses alt text for accessibility.
sophie: Thanks. Also can you add a short commit message like "rehost quickstart sample image to CDN" so it shows clearly in release notes?
ashok: Done. CI deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/8472 60 image loads and page returns 200.
michael: LGTM from me, quick semantic nit fixed.
sophie: Thanks everyone. I'll merge after the CI passes all checks. :raised_hands:
